Q1a.en: Every triangle is similar to itself, so \(R\) is reflexive. If \(T_1\) is similar to \(T_2\), then \(T_2\) is similar to \(T_1\), so \(R\) is symmetric. If \(T_1\) is similar to \(T_2\) and \(T_2\) is similar to \(T_3\), then \(T_1\) is similar to \(T_3\), so \(R\) is transitive. Hence \(R\) is an equivalence relation, which is the choice reflexive, symmetric and also transitive.
Q1a.hi: प्रत्येक त्रिभुज स्वयं के समरूप होता है, अतः \(R\) स्वतुल्य है। यदि \(T_1\), \(T_2\) के समरूप है, तो \(T_2\) भी \(T_1\) के समरूप है, अतः \(R\) सममित है। यदि \(T_1\), \(T_2\) के समरूप है और \(T_2\), \(T_3\) के समरूप है, तो \(T_1\), \(T_3\) के समरूप है, अतः \(R\) संक्रामक है। अतः \(R\) एक तुल्यता सम्बन्ध है, जो विकल्प स्वतुल्य है, सममित है और संक्रामक भी है।

Q1b.en: The function is not one-one: for example \(f(1.2) = f(1.5) = 1\), although \(1.2 \ne 1.5\). It is not onto either: \(f(x) = [x]\) takes only integer values, so a real number such as \(0.5\) in the co-domain \(R\) has no pre-image. Hence the function is the choice neither one-one nor onto.
Q1b.hi: यह फलन एकैकी नहीं है: उदाहरण के लिए \(f(1.2) = f(1.5) = 1\), जबकि \(1.2 \ne 1.5\)। यह आच्छादक भी नहीं है: \(f(x) = [x]\) केवल पूर्णांक मान लेता है, अतः सहप्रान्त \(R\) की वास्तविक संख्या \(0.5\) का कोई पूर्व-प्रतिबिम्ब नहीं है। अतः फलन विकल्प न तो एकैकी और न ही आच्छादक है।

Q1c.en: The order of a differential equation is the order of the highest derivative occurring in it. Here the highest derivative is \(\frac{d^3y}{dx^3}\), so the order is 3, which is the choice 3.
Q1c.hi: किसी अवकल समीकरण की कोटि उसमें उपस्थित उच्चतम अवकलज की कोटि होती है। यहाँ उच्चतम अवकलज \(\frac{d^3y}{dx^3}\) है, अतः कोटि 3 है, जो विकल्प 3 है।

Q1d.en:
\(\overrightarrow{PQ}\) is the position vector of the point \(Q\) minus that of the point \(P\):
\(\overrightarrow{PQ} = (-1-2)\hat{i} + (-2-3)\hat{j} + (-4-0)\hat{k} = -3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\), which is the choice \(-3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\).
Q1d.hi:
\(\overrightarrow{PQ}\) = बिन्दु \(Q\) का स्थिति सदिश घटा बिन्दु \(P\) का स्थिति सदिश:
\(\overrightarrow{PQ} = (-1-2)\hat{i} + (-2-3)\hat{j} + (-4-0)\hat{k} = -3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\), जो विकल्प \(-3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\) है।

Q1e.en:
Subtracting the matrix \(Y\) from \(2X + Y\):
\(2X = \begin{bmatrix} 1-3 & 0-2 \\ -3-1 & 2-4 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -2 & -2 \\ -4 & -2 \end{bmatrix}\), so \(X = \begin{bmatrix} -1 & -1 \\ -2 & -1 \end{bmatrix}\), which is the choice \(\begin{bmatrix} -1 & -1 \\ -2 & -1 \end{bmatrix}\).
Q1e.hi:
\(2X + Y\) में से आव्यूह \(Y\) घटाने पर:
\(2X = \begin{bmatrix} 1-3 & 0-2 \\ -3-1 & 2-4 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -2 & -2 \\ -4 & -2 \end{bmatrix}\), अतः \(X = \begin{bmatrix} -1 & -1 \\ -2 & -1 \end{bmatrix}\), जो विकल्प \(\begin{bmatrix} -1 & -1 \\ -2 & -1 \end{bmatrix}\) है।

Q2a.en: The principal value branch of \(\operatorname{cosec}^{-1}\) is \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right] - \{0\}\). Since \(\operatorname{cosec}\left(-\frac{\pi}{4}\right) = -\operatorname{cosec}\frac{\pi}{4} = -\sqrt{2}\) and \(-\frac{\pi}{4}\) lies in this branch, the principal value of \(\operatorname{cosec}^{-1}(-\sqrt{2})\) is \(-\frac{\pi}{4}\).
Q2a.hi: \(\operatorname{cosec}^{-1}\) की मुख्य मान शाखा \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right] - \{0\}\) है। चूँकि \(\operatorname{cosec}\left(-\frac{\pi}{4}\right) = -\operatorname{cosec}\frac{\pi}{4} = -\sqrt{2}\) तथा \(-\frac{\pi}{4}\) इस शाखा में है, अतः \(\operatorname{cosec}^{-1}(-\sqrt{2})\) का मुख्य मान \(-\frac{\pi}{4}\) है।

Q2b.en:
At \(x = \pi\): \(f(\pi) = \pi^2 - \sin\pi + 5 = \pi^2 + 5\).
Since \(x^2\), \(\sin x\) and constants are continuous, \(\lim_{x \to \pi} f(x) = \pi^2 - \sin\pi + 5 = \pi^2 + 5\).
As \(\lim_{x \to \pi} f(x) = f(\pi)\), the function is continuous at \(x = \pi\).
Q2b.hi:
\(x = \pi\) पर: \(f(\pi) = \pi^2 - \sin\pi + 5 = \pi^2 + 5\)।
चूँकि \(x^2\), \(\sin x\) तथा अचर फलन सतत हैं, अतः \(\lim_{x \to \pi} f(x) = \pi^2 - \sin\pi + 5 = \pi^2 + 5\)।
चूँकि \(\lim_{x \to \pi} f(x) = f(\pi)\), अतः फलन \(x = \pi\) पर सतत है।

Q2c.en:
Expanding the integrand and using the standard integrals:
\(\int \operatorname{cosec} x(\operatorname{cosec} x + \cot x)\,dx = \int \operatorname{cosec}^2 x\,dx + \int \operatorname{cosec} x \cot x\,dx = -\cot x - \operatorname{cosec} x + C\).
Q2c.hi:
समाकल्य को खोलकर मानक समाकलों का प्रयोग करने पर:
\(\int \operatorname{cosec} x(\operatorname{cosec} x + \cot x)\,dx = \int \operatorname{cosec}^2 x\,dx + \int \operatorname{cosec} x \cot x\,dx = -\cot x - \operatorname{cosec} x + C\)।

Q2e.en: The \(y\)-axis makes angles \(90^\circ\), \(0^\circ\) and \(90^\circ\) with the \(x\)-, \(y\)- and \(z\)-axes. So its direction cosines are \(\cos 90^\circ, \cos 0^\circ, \cos 90^\circ\), that is, \(0, 1, 0\).
Q2e.hi: \(y\)-अक्ष, \(x\)-, \(y\)- तथा \(z\)-अक्षों से क्रमशः \(90^\circ\), \(0^\circ\) तथा \(90^\circ\) के कोण बनाता है। अतः इसकी दिक्-कोज्याएँ \(\cos 90^\circ, \cos 0^\circ, \cos 90^\circ\) अर्थात् \(0, 1, 0\) हैं।

Q3a.en:
Let \(y = x^{\sin x}\), \(x > 0\). Taking logarithms on both sides:
\(\log y = \sin x \log x\).
Differentiating with respect to \(x\):
\(\frac{1}{y}\frac{dy}{dx} = \cos x \log x + \sin x \cdot \frac{1}{x}\).
Hence \(\frac{dy}{dx} = x^{\sin x}\left(\cos x \log x + \frac{\sin x}{x}\right)\).
Q3a.hi:
माना \(y = x^{\sin x}\), \(x > 0\)। दोनों पक्षों का लघुगणक लेने पर:
\(\log y = \sin x \log x\)।
\(x\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{1}{y}\frac{dy}{dx} = \cos x \log x + \sin x \cdot \frac{1}{x}\)।
अतः \(\frac{dy}{dx} = x^{\sin x}\left(\cos x \log x + \frac{\sin x}{x}\right)\)।

Q3b.en:
Put \(x = a\sec\theta\), so \(dx = a\sec\theta\tan\theta\,d\theta\) and \(\sqrt{x^2 - a^2} = a\tan\theta\).
\(\int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{x^2 - a^2}} = \int \frac{a\sec\theta\tan\theta}{a\tan\theta}\,d\theta = \int \sec\theta\,d\theta = \log|\sec\theta + \tan\theta| + C_1\)
\(= \log\left|\frac{x}{a} + \frac{\sqrt{x^2 - a^2}}{a}\right| + C_1 = \log\left|x + \sqrt{x^2 - a^2}\right| - \log|a| + C_1\).
Hence \(\int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{x^2 - a^2}} = \log\left|x + \sqrt{x^2 - a^2}\right| + C\), where \(C = C_1 - \log|a|\).
Q3b.hi:
माना \(x = a\sec\theta\), तब \(dx = a\sec\theta\tan\theta\,d\theta\) तथा \(\sqrt{x^2 - a^2} = a\tan\theta\)।
\(\int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{x^2 - a^2}} = \int \frac{a\sec\theta\tan\theta}{a\tan\theta}\,d\theta = \int \sec\theta\,d\theta = \log|\sec\theta + \tan\theta| + C_1\)
\(= \log\left|\frac{x}{a} + \frac{\sqrt{x^2 - a^2}}{a}\right| + C_1 = \log\left|x + \sqrt{x^2 - a^2}\right| - \log|a| + C_1\)।
अतः \(\int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{x^2 - a^2}} = \log\left|x + \sqrt{x^2 - a^2}\right| + C\), जहाँ \(C = C_1 - \log|a|\)।

Q3c.en:
**Reflexive:** for any \((a, b) \in N \times N\), \(a + b = b + a\), so \((a, b)\,R\,(a, b)\).

**Symmetric:** let \((a, b)\,R\,(c, d)\). Then \(a + d = b + c\), that is, \(c + b = d + a\), so \((c, d)\,R\,(a, b)\).

**Transitive:** let \((a, b)\,R\,(c, d)\) and \((c, d)\,R\,(e, f)\). Then \(a + d = b + c\) and \(c + f = d + e\). Adding, \(a + d + c + f = b + c + d + e\), so \(a + f = b + e\), that is, \((a, b)\,R\,(e, f)\).

Since \(R\) is reflexive, symmetric and transitive, \(R\) is an equivalence relation.
Q3c.hi:
**स्वतुल्य:** किसी भी \((a, b) \in N \times N\) के लिए \(a + b = b + a\), अतः \((a, b)\,R\,(a, b)\)।

**सममित:** माना \((a, b)\,R\,(c, d)\)। तब \(a + d = b + c\) अर्थात् \(c + b = d + a\), अतः \((c, d)\,R\,(a, b)\)।

**संक्रामक:** माना \((a, b)\,R\,(c, d)\) तथा \((c, d)\,R\,(e, f)\)। तब \(a + d = b + c\) तथा \(c + f = d + e\)। जोड़ने पर \(a + d + c + f = b + c + d + e\), अतः \(a + f = b + e\) अर्थात् \((a, b)\,R\,(e, f)\)।

चूँकि \(R\) स्वतुल्य, सममित तथा संक्रामक है, अतः \(R\) एक तुल्यता सम्बन्ध है।

Q3d.en:
The projection of \(\vec{a}\) on \(\vec{b}\) is \(\frac{\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}}{|\vec{b}|}\).
\(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = (2)(1) + (3)(2) + (2)(1) = 10\) and \(|\vec{b}| = \sqrt{1^2 + 2^2 + 1^2} = \sqrt{6}\).
So the projection is \(\frac{10}{\sqrt{6}} = \frac{5\sqrt{6}}{3}\).

Q4a.en:
By partial fractions, \(\frac{1}{(x+1)(x+2)} = \frac{1}{x+1} - \frac{1}{x+2}\).
So \(\int \frac{dx}{(x+1)(x+2)} = \int \frac{dx}{x+1} - \int \frac{dx}{x+2} = \log|x+1| - \log|x+2| + C = \log\left|\frac{x+1}{x+2}\right| + C\).
Q4a.hi:
आंशिक भिन्नों में वियोजित करने पर \(\frac{1}{(x+1)(x+2)} = \frac{1}{x+1} - \frac{1}{x+2}\)।
अतः \(\int \frac{dx}{(x+1)(x+2)} = \int \frac{dx}{x+1} - \int \frac{dx}{x+2} = \log|x+1| - \log|x+2| + C = \log\left|\frac{x+1}{x+2}\right| + C\)।

Q4b.en:
A leap year has 366 days, that is, 52 complete weeks and 2 extra days. The 52 weeks give 52 Tuesdays, so there are 53 Tuesdays only if one of the 2 extra days is a Tuesday.
The 2 extra days can be any one of 7 equally likely pairs: (Sunday, Monday), (Monday, Tuesday), (Tuesday, Wednesday), (Wednesday, Thursday), (Thursday, Friday), (Friday, Saturday), (Saturday, Sunday).
Two of these pairs contain a Tuesday, so the required probability is \(\frac{2}{7}\).
Q4b.hi:
अधिवर्ष में 366 दिन होते हैं, अर्थात् 52 पूरे सप्ताह और 2 अतिरिक्त दिन। 52 सप्ताहों में 52 मंगलवार होते हैं, अतः 53 मंगलवार तभी होंगे जब 2 अतिरिक्त दिनों में से एक मंगलवार हो।
2 अतिरिक्त दिन इन 7 समसम्भावी युग्मों में से कोई एक हो सकते हैं: (रविवार, सोमवार), (सोमवार, मंगलवार), (मंगलवार, बुधवार), (बुधवार, गुरुवार), (गुरुवार, शुक्रवार), (शुक्रवार, शनिवार), (शनिवार, रविवार)।
इनमें से दो युग्मों में मंगलवार है, अतः अभीष्ट प्रायिकता \(\frac{2}{7}\) है।

Q4c.en:
The transpose of the matrix \(A\) is \(A' = \begin{bmatrix} \cos\alpha & -\sin\alpha \\ \sin\alpha & \cos\alpha \end{bmatrix}\).
\(A'A = \begin{bmatrix} \cos\alpha & -\sin\alpha \\ \sin\alpha & \cos\alpha \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} \cos\alpha & \sin\alpha \\ -\sin\alpha & \cos\alpha \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \cos^2\alpha + \sin^2\alpha & \cos\alpha\sin\alpha - \sin\alpha\cos\alpha \\ \sin\alpha\cos\alpha - \cos\alpha\sin\alpha & \sin^2\alpha + \cos^2\alpha \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix} = I\).
Hence \(A'A = I\) is verified.
Q4c.hi:
आव्यूह \(A\) का परिवर्त \(A' = \begin{bmatrix} \cos\alpha & -\sin\alpha \\ \sin\alpha & \cos\alpha \end{bmatrix}\) है।
\(A'A = \begin{bmatrix} \cos\alpha & -\sin\alpha \\ \sin\alpha & \cos\alpha \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} \cos\alpha & \sin\alpha \\ -\sin\alpha & \cos\alpha \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \cos^2\alpha + \sin^2\alpha & \cos\alpha\sin\alpha - \sin\alpha\cos\alpha \\ \sin\alpha\cos\alpha - \cos\alpha\sin\alpha & \sin^2\alpha + \cos^2\alpha \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix} = I\)।
अतः \(A'A = I\) सत्यापित हुआ।

Q4d.en:
\(f(x) = x^3 - 3x^2 + 4x\), so \(f'(x) = 3x^2 - 6x + 4 = 3(x^2 - 2x + 1) + 1 = 3(x - 1)^2 + 1\).
Since \(3(x - 1)^2 \ge 0\) for every real \(x\), \(f'(x) \ge 1 > 0\) for all \(x \in R\). Hence \(f\) is an increasing function in \(R\).

Q5a.en:
Let \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} a^2+1 & ab & ac \\ ab & b^2+1 & bc \\ ca & cb & c^2+1 \end{vmatrix}\). First take \(a, b, c\) non-zero.

Multiplying \(R_1, R_2, R_3\) by \(a, b, c\) respectively and dividing by \(abc\):
\(\Delta = \frac{1}{abc}\begin{vmatrix} a(a^2+1) & a^2b & a^2c \\ ab^2 & b(b^2+1) & b^2c \\ ac^2 & bc^2 & c(c^2+1) \end{vmatrix}\).

Taking \(a, b, c\) common from \(C_1, C_2, C_3\) respectively:
\(\Delta = \frac{abc}{abc}\begin{vmatrix} a^2+1 & a^2 & a^2 \\ b^2 & b^2+1 & b^2 \\ c^2 & c^2 & c^2+1 \end{vmatrix} = \begin{vmatrix} a^2+1 & a^2 & a^2 \\ b^2 & b^2+1 & b^2 \\ c^2 & c^2 & c^2+1 \end{vmatrix}\).

Applying \(C_2 \rightarrow C_2 - C_1\) and \(C_3 \rightarrow C_3 - C_1\):
\(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} a^2+1 & -1 & -1 \\ b^2 & 1 & 0 \\ c^2 & 0 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\).

Expanding along \(R_1\):
\(\Delta = (a^2+1)(1 \cdot 1 - 0 \cdot 0) - (-1)(b^2 \cdot 1 - 0 \cdot c^2) + (-1)(b^2 \cdot 0 - 1 \cdot c^2)\)
\(= a^2 + 1 + b^2 + c^2\).

Both sides are polynomials in \(a, b, c\), so the result holds for all values, including zero. Hence \(\Delta = 1 + a^2 + b^2 + c^2\).
Q5a.hi:
माना \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} a^2+1 & ab & ac \\ ab & b^2+1 & bc \\ ca & cb & c^2+1 \end{vmatrix}\)। पहले \(a, b, c\) को शून्येतर मानते हैं।

\(R_1, R_2, R_3\) को क्रमशः \(a, b, c\) से गुणा करके \(abc\) से भाग देने पर:
\(\Delta = \frac{1}{abc}\begin{vmatrix} a(a^2+1) & a^2b & a^2c \\ ab^2 & b(b^2+1) & b^2c \\ ac^2 & bc^2 & c(c^2+1) \end{vmatrix}\)।

\(C_1, C_2, C_3\) से क्रमशः \(a, b, c\) उभयनिष्ठ लेने पर:
\(\Delta = \frac{abc}{abc}\begin{vmatrix} a^2+1 & a^2 & a^2 \\ b^2 & b^2+1 & b^2 \\ c^2 & c^2 & c^2+1 \end{vmatrix} = \begin{vmatrix} a^2+1 & a^2 & a^2 \\ b^2 & b^2+1 & b^2 \\ c^2 & c^2 & c^2+1 \end{vmatrix}\)।

\(C_2 \rightarrow C_2 - C_1\) तथा \(C_3 \rightarrow C_3 - C_1\) का प्रयोग करने पर:
\(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} a^2+1 & -1 & -1 \\ b^2 & 1 & 0 \\ c^2 & 0 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\)।

\(R_1\) के अनुदिश प्रसार करने पर:
\(\Delta = (a^2+1)(1 \cdot 1 - 0 \cdot 0) - (-1)(b^2 \cdot 1 - 0 \cdot c^2) + (-1)(b^2 \cdot 0 - 1 \cdot c^2)\)
\(= a^2 + 1 + b^2 + c^2\)।

दोनों पक्ष \(a, b, c\) के बहुपद हैं, अतः यह परिणाम शून्य सहित सभी मानों के लिए सत्य है। अतः \(\Delta = 1 + a^2 + b^2 + c^2\)।

Q5b.en:
Given \(y = (\tan^{-1} x)^2\). Differentiating with respect to \(x\):
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = 2\tan^{-1} x \cdot \frac{1}{1+x^2}\), so \((1+x^2)\frac{dy}{dx} = 2\tan^{-1} x\).

Differentiating again with respect to \(x\):
\((1+x^2)\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + 2x\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{2}{1+x^2}\).

Multiplying both sides by \((1+x^2)\):
\((x^2+1)^2\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + 2x(x^2+1)\frac{dy}{dx} = 2\).
Hence proved.
Q5b.hi:
दिया है \(y = (\tan^{-1} x)^2\)। \(x\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = 2\tan^{-1} x \cdot \frac{1}{1+x^2}\), अतः \((1+x^2)\frac{dy}{dx} = 2\tan^{-1} x\)।

\(x\) के सापेक्ष पुनः अवकलन करने पर:
\((1+x^2)\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + 2x\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{2}{1+x^2}\)।

दोनों पक्षों को \((1+x^2)\) से गुणा करने पर:
\((x^2+1)^2\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + 2x(x^2+1)\frac{dy}{dx} = 2\)।
इति सिद्धम्।

Q5c.en:
Comparing with \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_1 + \lambda\vec{b}_1\) and \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_2 + \mu\vec{b}_2\):
\(\vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}\), \(\vec{b}_1 = \hat{i} - 3\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\), \(\vec{a}_2 = 4\hat{i} + 5\hat{j} + 6\hat{k}\), \(\vec{b}_2 = 2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + \hat{k}\).

The shortest distance is \(d = \left|\frac{(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1)}{|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2|}\right|\).

\(\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1 = 3\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}\).

\(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2 = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 1 & -3 & 2 \\ 2 & 3 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(-3 - 6) - \hat{j}(1 - 4) + \hat{k}(3 + 6) = -9\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 9\hat{k}\).

\(|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2| = \sqrt{81 + 9 + 81} = \sqrt{171} = 3\sqrt{19}\).

\((\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1) = (-9)(3) + (3)(3) + (9)(3) = -27 + 9 + 27 = 9\).

So \(d = \frac{9}{3\sqrt{19}} = \frac{3}{\sqrt{19}} = \frac{3\sqrt{19}}{19}\) units.
Q5c.hi:
\(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_1 + \lambda\vec{b}_1\) तथा \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_2 + \mu\vec{b}_2\) से तुलना करने पर:
\(\vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}\), \(\vec{b}_1 = \hat{i} - 3\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\), \(\vec{a}_2 = 4\hat{i} + 5\hat{j} + 6\hat{k}\), \(\vec{b}_2 = 2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + \hat{k}\)।

न्यूनतम दूरी \(d = \left|\frac{(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1)}{|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2|}\right|\)।

\(\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1 = 3\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}\)।

\(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2 = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 1 & -3 & 2 \\ 2 & 3 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(-3 - 6) - \hat{j}(1 - 4) + \hat{k}(3 + 6) = -9\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 9\hat{k}\)।

\(|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2| = \sqrt{81 + 9 + 81} = \sqrt{171} = 3\sqrt{19}\)।

\((\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1) = (-9)(3) + (3)(3) + (9)(3) = -27 + 9 + 27 = 9\)।

अतः \(d = \frac{9}{3\sqrt{19}} = \frac{3}{\sqrt{19}} = \frac{3\sqrt{19}}{19}\) इकाई।

Q5d.en:
Put \(x = \cos 2\theta\). Since \(-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \le x \le 1\), we have \(0 \le 2\theta \le \frac{3\pi}{4}\), that is, \(0 \le \theta \le \frac{3\pi}{8}\), and \(\theta = \frac{1}{2}\cos^{-1} x\).

In this range \(\cos\theta \ge 0\) and \(\sin\theta \ge 0\), so
\(\sqrt{1+x} = \sqrt{1+\cos 2\theta} = \sqrt{2\cos^2\theta} = \sqrt{2}\cos\theta\) and \(\sqrt{1-x} = \sqrt{1-\cos 2\theta} = \sqrt{2\sin^2\theta} = \sqrt{2}\sin\theta\).

Then
\(\frac{\sqrt{1+x} - \sqrt{1-x}}{\sqrt{1+x} + \sqrt{1-x}} = \frac{\cos\theta - \sin\theta}{\cos\theta + \sin\theta} = \frac{1 - \tan\theta}{1 + \tan\theta} = \tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - \theta\right)\)
(dividing numerator and denominator by \(\cos\theta\)).

Since \(0 \le \theta \le \frac{3\pi}{8}\), \(-\frac{\pi}{8} \le \frac{\pi}{4} - \theta \le \frac{\pi}{4}\), which lies in \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\). Therefore
\(\text{LHS} = \tan^{-1}\left[\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - \theta\right)\right] = \frac{\pi}{4} - \theta = \frac{\pi}{4} - \frac{1}{2}\cos^{-1} x = \text{RHS}\).
Hence proved.
Q5d.hi:
माना \(x = \cos 2\theta\)। चूँकि \(-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \le x \le 1\), अतः \(0 \le 2\theta \le \frac{3\pi}{4}\) अर्थात् \(0 \le \theta \le \frac{3\pi}{8}\), तथा \(\theta = \frac{1}{2}\cos^{-1} x\)।

इस अन्तराल में \(\cos\theta \ge 0\) तथा \(\sin\theta \ge 0\), अतः
\(\sqrt{1+x} = \sqrt{1+\cos 2\theta} = \sqrt{2\cos^2\theta} = \sqrt{2}\cos\theta\) तथा \(\sqrt{1-x} = \sqrt{1-\cos 2\theta} = \sqrt{2\sin^2\theta} = \sqrt{2}\sin\theta\)।

तब
\(\frac{\sqrt{1+x} - \sqrt{1-x}}{\sqrt{1+x} + \sqrt{1-x}} = \frac{\cos\theta - \sin\theta}{\cos\theta + \sin\theta} = \frac{1 - \tan\theta}{1 + \tan\theta} = \tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - \theta\right)\)
(अंश और हर को \(\cos\theta\) से भाग देने पर)।

चूँकि \(0 \le \theta \le \frac{3\pi}{8}\), अतः \(-\frac{\pi}{8} \le \frac{\pi}{4} - \theta \le \frac{\pi}{4}\), जो \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) में है। अतः
\(\text{बायाँ पक्ष} = \tan^{-1}\left[\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - \theta\right)\right] = \frac{\pi}{4} - \theta = \frac{\pi}{4} - \frac{1}{2}\cos^{-1} x = \text{दायाँ पक्ष}\)।
इति सिद्धम्।

Q5e.en:
Dividing by \(x\) (\(x \ne 0\)):
\(\frac{dy}{dx} + \frac{2}{x}y = x\).
This is a linear differential equation of the form \(\frac{dy}{dx} + Py = Q\) with \(P = \frac{2}{x}\) and \(Q = x\).

Integrating factor: \(\text{I.F.} = e^{\int \frac{2}{x}\,dx} = e^{2\log|x|} = x^2\).

The solution is \(y \cdot \text{I.F.} = \int Q \cdot \text{I.F.}\,dx + C\):
\(y x^2 = \int x \cdot x^2\,dx + C = \frac{x^4}{4} + C\).

Hence the general solution is \(y = \frac{x^2}{4} + C x^{-2}\), where \(C\) is an arbitrary constant.
Q5e.hi:
\(x\) से भाग देने पर (\(x \ne 0\)):
\(\frac{dy}{dx} + \frac{2}{x}y = x\)।
यह \(\frac{dy}{dx} + Py = Q\) के रूप का रैखिक अवकल समीकरण है, जहाँ \(P = \frac{2}{x}\) तथा \(Q = x\)।

समाकलन गुणांक: \(\text{I.F.} = e^{\int \frac{2}{x}\,dx} = e^{2\log|x|} = x^2\)।

हल \(y \cdot \text{I.F.} = \int Q \cdot \text{I.F.}\,dx + C\) होता है:
\(y x^2 = \int x \cdot x^2\,dx + C = \frac{x^4}{4} + C\)।

अतः व्यापक हल \(y = \frac{x^2}{4} + C x^{-2}\) है, जहाँ \(C\) स्वेच्छ अचर है।

Q6a.en:
When a die is thrown twice, the sample space has \(6 \times 6 = 36\) equally likely outcomes.

Let \(E\): the sum of the numbers is 6, and \(F\): the number 4 appears at least once.
\(E = \{(1, 5), (2, 4), (3, 3), (4, 2), (5, 1)\}\), so \(P(E) = \frac{5}{36}\).
\(F = \{(4, 1), (4, 2), (4, 3), (4, 4), (4, 5), (4, 6), (1, 4), (2, 4), (3, 4), (5, 4), (6, 4)\}\).
\(E \cap F = \{(2, 4), (4, 2)\}\), so \(P(E \cap F) = \frac{2}{36}\).

Required probability:
\(P(F/E) = \frac{P(E \cap F)}{P(E)} = \frac{2/36}{5/36} = \frac{2}{5}\).

Q6b.en:
Draw the lines \(x + y = 1\) (through \((1, 0)\) and \((0, 1)\)) and \(-x + y = 0\), that is, \(y = x\) (through \((0, 0)\) and \((1, 1)\)).

- \(x + y \le 1\): the origin satisfies it, so the region is on the origin side of \(x + y = 1\).
- \(-x + y \le 0\), that is, \(y \le x\): the point \((1, 0)\) satisfies it, so the region is below the line \(y = x\).
- \(x \ge 0, y \ge 0\): the region is in the first quadrant.

The lines \(x + y = 1\) and \(y = x\) meet at \(\left(\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{2}\right)\). So the feasible region is the triangle with corner points \(O(0, 0)\), \(P(1, 0)\) and \(Q\left(\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{2}\right)\). It is bounded, so the maximum of \(Z\) occurs at a corner point.

| Corner point | \(Z = x + 2y\) |
|---|---|
| \(O(0, 0)\) | \(0\) |
| \(P(1, 0)\) | \(1\) |
| \(Q\left(\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{2}\right)\) | \(\frac{1}{2} + 1 = \frac{3}{2}\) |

Hence the maximum value of \(Z\) is \(\frac{3}{2}\), at \(x = \frac{1}{2}, y = \frac{1}{2}\).

Q6c.en:
If \(\vec{a}\) and \(\vec{b}\) are the diagonals of a parallelogram, its area is \(\frac{1}{2}|\vec{a} \times \vec{b}|\).

\(\vec{a} \times \vec{b} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 3 & 1 & -2 \\ 1 & -3 & 4 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(4 - 6) - \hat{j}(12 + 2) + \hat{k}(-9 - 1) = -2\hat{i} - 14\hat{j} - 10\hat{k}\).

\(|\vec{a} \times \vec{b}| = \sqrt{4 + 196 + 100} = \sqrt{300} = 10\sqrt{3}\).

Hence the area of the parallelogram is \(\frac{1}{2} \times 10\sqrt{3} = 5\sqrt{3}\) square units.
Q6c.hi:
यदि \(\vec{a}\) तथा \(\vec{b}\) किसी समान्तर चतुर्भुज के विकर्ण हों, तो उसका क्षेत्रफल \(\frac{1}{2}|\vec{a} \times \vec{b}|\) होता है।

\(\vec{a} \times \vec{b} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 3 & 1 & -2 \\ 1 & -3 & 4 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(4 - 6) - \hat{j}(12 + 2) + \hat{k}(-9 - 1) = -2\hat{i} - 14\hat{j} - 10\hat{k}\)।

\(|\vec{a} \times \vec{b}| = \sqrt{4 + 196 + 100} = \sqrt{300} = 10\sqrt{3}\)।

अतः समान्तर चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल \(\frac{1}{2} \times 10\sqrt{3} = 5\sqrt{3}\) वर्ग इकाई है।

Q6d.en:
Since \(\hat{a}\) and \(\hat{b}\) are unit vectors, \(|\hat{a}| = |\hat{b}| = 1\) and \(\hat{a} \cdot \hat{b} = \cos\theta\).

\(|\hat{a} - \hat{b}|^2 = (\hat{a} - \hat{b}) \cdot (\hat{a} - \hat{b}) = |\hat{a}|^2 - 2\,\hat{a} \cdot \hat{b} + |\hat{b}|^2 = 1 - 2\cos\theta + 1 = 2(1 - \cos\theta) = 4\sin^2\frac{\theta}{2}\).

Since \(0 \le \theta \le \pi\), \(\sin\frac{\theta}{2} \ge 0\), so \(|\hat{a} - \hat{b}| = 2\sin\frac{\theta}{2}\).

Hence \(\sin\frac{\theta}{2} = \frac{1}{2}|\hat{a} - \hat{b}|\). Proved.
Q6d.hi:
चूँकि \(\hat{a}\) तथा \(\hat{b}\) इकाई सदिश हैं, अतः \(|\hat{a}| = |\hat{b}| = 1\) तथा \(\hat{a} \cdot \hat{b} = \cos\theta\)।

\(|\hat{a} - \hat{b}|^2 = (\hat{a} - \hat{b}) \cdot (\hat{a} - \hat{b}) = |\hat{a}|^2 - 2\,\hat{a} \cdot \hat{b} + |\hat{b}|^2 = 1 - 2\cos\theta + 1 = 2(1 - \cos\theta) = 4\sin^2\frac{\theta}{2}\)।

चूँकि \(0 \le \theta \le \pi\), अतः \(\sin\frac{\theta}{2} \ge 0\), इसलिए \(|\hat{a} - \hat{b}| = 2\sin\frac{\theta}{2}\)।

अतः \(\sin\frac{\theta}{2} = \frac{1}{2}|\hat{a} - \hat{b}|\)। इति सिद्धम्।

Q6e.en:
Let \(r\) be the radius, \(h\) the height and \(V\) the volume of the cone at time \(t\). Given \(\frac{dV}{dt} = 12\) cm\(^3\)/s and \(h = \frac{r}{6}\), that is, \(r = 6h\).

\(V = \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h = \frac{1}{3}\pi (6h)^2 h = 12\pi h^3\).

Differentiating with respect to \(t\):
\(\frac{dV}{dt} = 36\pi h^2 \frac{dh}{dt}\).

When \(h = 4\) cm:
\(12 = 36\pi (4)^2 \frac{dh}{dt} = 576\pi \frac{dh}{dt}\), so \(\frac{dh}{dt} = \frac{12}{576\pi} = \frac{1}{48\pi}\).

Hence the height of the cone is increasing at the rate of \(\frac{1}{48\pi}\) cm/s.
Q6e.hi:
माना समय \(t\) पर शंकु की त्रिज्या \(r\), ऊँचाई \(h\) तथा आयतन \(V\) है। दिया है \(\frac{dV}{dt} = 12\) सेमी\(^3\)/सेकण्ड तथा \(h = \frac{r}{6}\) अर्थात् \(r = 6h\)।

\(V = \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h = \frac{1}{3}\pi (6h)^2 h = 12\pi h^3\)।

\(t\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{dV}{dt} = 36\pi h^2 \frac{dh}{dt}\)।

जब \(h = 4\) सेमी:
\(12 = 36\pi (4)^2 \frac{dh}{dt} = 576\pi \frac{dh}{dt}\), अतः \(\frac{dh}{dt} = \frac{12}{576\pi} = \frac{1}{48\pi}\)।

अतः शंकु की ऊँचाई \(\frac{1}{48\pi}\) सेमी/सेकण्ड की दर से बढ़ रही है।

Q7b.en:
We have \(F(x) = \begin{bmatrix} \cos x & -\sin x & 0 \\ \sin x & \cos x & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\) and \(F(y) = \begin{bmatrix} \cos y & -\sin y & 0 \\ \sin y & \cos y & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\).

Multiplying row by column:
\(F(x)F(y) = \begin{bmatrix} \cos x\cos y - \sin x\sin y & -\cos x\sin y - \sin x\cos y & 0 \\ \sin x\cos y + \cos x\sin y & -\sin x\sin y + \cos x\cos y & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\).

Using \(\cos(x+y) = \cos x\cos y - \sin x\sin y\) and \(\sin(x+y) = \sin x\cos y + \cos x\sin y\):
\(F(x)F(y) = \begin{bmatrix} \cos(x+y) & -\sin(x+y) & 0 \\ \sin(x+y) & \cos(x+y) & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix} = F(x+y)\).

Hence \(F(x)F(y) = F(x+y)\). Proved.
Q7b.hi:
यहाँ \(F(x) = \begin{bmatrix} \cos x & -\sin x & 0 \\ \sin x & \cos x & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\) तथा \(F(y) = \begin{bmatrix} \cos y & -\sin y & 0 \\ \sin y & \cos y & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\)।

पंक्ति को स्तम्भ से गुणा करने पर:
\(F(x)F(y) = \begin{bmatrix} \cos x\cos y - \sin x\sin y & -\cos x\sin y - \sin x\cos y & 0 \\ \sin x\cos y + \cos x\sin y & -\sin x\sin y + \cos x\cos y & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\)।

\(\cos(x+y) = \cos x\cos y - \sin x\sin y\) तथा \(\sin(x+y) = \sin x\cos y + \cos x\sin y\) का प्रयोग करने पर:
\(F(x)F(y) = \begin{bmatrix} \cos(x+y) & -\sin(x+y) & 0 \\ \sin(x+y) & \cos(x+y) & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix} = F(x+y)\)।

अतः \(F(x)F(y) = F(x+y)\)। इति सिद्धम्।

Q8a.en:
Let \(l\) be the given (fixed) slant height and \(\theta\) the semi-vertical angle of the cone, \(0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\). Then the radius is \(r = l\sin\theta\) and the height is \(h = l\cos\theta\).

Volume:
\(V = \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h = \frac{1}{3}\pi l^3 \sin^2\theta \cos\theta\).

Differentiating with respect to \(\theta\):
\(\frac{dV}{d\theta} = \frac{1}{3}\pi l^3\left(2\sin\theta\cos^2\theta - \sin^3\theta\right) = \frac{1}{3}\pi l^3 \sin\theta\left(2\cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta\right)\).

For a maximum or minimum, \(\frac{dV}{d\theta} = 0\). Since \(\sin\theta \ne 0\):
\(2\cos^2\theta = \sin^2\theta \Rightarrow \tan^2\theta = 2 \Rightarrow \tan\theta = \sqrt{2}\) (as \(\theta\) is acute).

Second derivative:
\(\frac{d^2V}{d\theta^2} = \frac{1}{3}\pi l^3\left(2\cos^3\theta - 4\sin^2\theta\cos\theta - 3\sin^2\theta\cos\theta\right) = \frac{1}{3}\pi l^3 \cos\theta\left(2\cos^2\theta - 7\sin^2\theta\right)\).

When \(\tan\theta = \sqrt{2}\): \(\cos^2\theta = \frac{1}{3}\), \(\sin^2\theta = \frac{2}{3}\), so \(2\cos^2\theta - 7\sin^2\theta = \frac{2}{3} - \frac{14}{3} = -4 < 0\), and \(\cos\theta > 0\). Thus \(\frac{d^2V}{d\theta^2} < 0\).

Hence the volume is maximum when \(\tan\theta = \sqrt{2}\), that is, the semi-vertical angle is \(\theta = \tan^{-1}\sqrt{2}\). Proved.
Q8a.hi:
माना शंकु की दी हुई (नियत) तिर्यक ऊँचाई \(l\) तथा अर्धशीर्ष कोण \(\theta\) है, \(0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\)। तब त्रिज्या \(r = l\sin\theta\) तथा ऊँचाई \(h = l\cos\theta\)।

आयतन:
\(V = \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h = \frac{1}{3}\pi l^3 \sin^2\theta \cos\theta\)।

\(\theta\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{dV}{d\theta} = \frac{1}{3}\pi l^3\left(2\sin\theta\cos^2\theta - \sin^3\theta\right) = \frac{1}{3}\pi l^3 \sin\theta\left(2\cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta\right)\)।

उच्चिष्ठ या निम्निष्ठ के लिए \(\frac{dV}{d\theta} = 0\)। चूँकि \(\sin\theta \ne 0\):
\(2\cos^2\theta = \sin^2\theta \Rightarrow \tan^2\theta = 2 \Rightarrow \tan\theta = \sqrt{2}\) (क्योंकि \(\theta\) न्यूनकोण है)।

द्वितीय अवकलज:
\(\frac{d^2V}{d\theta^2} = \frac{1}{3}\pi l^3\left(2\cos^3\theta - 4\sin^2\theta\cos\theta - 3\sin^2\theta\cos\theta\right) = \frac{1}{3}\pi l^3 \cos\theta\left(2\cos^2\theta - 7\sin^2\theta\right)\)।

जब \(\tan\theta = \sqrt{2}\): \(\cos^2\theta = \frac{1}{3}\), \(\sin^2\theta = \frac{2}{3}\), अतः \(2\cos^2\theta - 7\sin^2\theta = \frac{2}{3} - \frac{14}{3} = -4 < 0\) तथा \(\cos\theta > 0\)। इस प्रकार \(\frac{d^2V}{d\theta^2} < 0\)।

अतः आयतन महत्तम है जब \(\tan\theta = \sqrt{2}\), अर्थात् अर्धशीर्ष कोण \(\theta = \tan^{-1}\sqrt{2}\) है। इति सिद्धम्।

Q8b.en:
Let \(I = \int_{0}^{\pi/4} \log(1 + \tan x)\,dx\). \(\quad (1)\)

Using the property \(\int_{0}^{a} f(x)\,dx = \int_{0}^{a} f(a - x)\,dx\):
\(I = \int_{0}^{\pi/4} \log\left[1 + \tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - x\right)\right]dx\).

Now \(\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - x\right) = \frac{1 - \tan x}{1 + \tan x}\), so
\(1 + \tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - x\right) = \frac{1 + \tan x + 1 - \tan x}{1 + \tan x} = \frac{2}{1 + \tan x}\).

Therefore
\(I = \int_{0}^{\pi/4} \log\frac{2}{1 + \tan x}\,dx = \int_{0}^{\pi/4} \log 2\,dx - \int_{0}^{\pi/4} \log(1 + \tan x)\,dx = \frac{\pi}{4}\log 2 - I\), using (1).

So \(2I = \frac{\pi}{4}\log 2\), and \(I = \frac{\pi}{8}\log 2\).
Hence \(\int_{0}^{\pi/4} \log(1 + \tan x)\,dx = \frac{\pi}{8}\log 2\). Proved.
Q8b.hi:
माना \(I = \int_{0}^{\pi/4} \log(1 + \tan x)\,dx\)। \(\quad (1)\)

गुणधर्म \(\int_{0}^{a} f(x)\,dx = \int_{0}^{a} f(a - x)\,dx\) का प्रयोग करने पर:
\(I = \int_{0}^{\pi/4} \log\left[1 + \tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - x\right)\right]dx\)।

अब \(\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - x\right) = \frac{1 - \tan x}{1 + \tan x}\), अतः
\(1 + \tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - x\right) = \frac{1 + \tan x + 1 - \tan x}{1 + \tan x} = \frac{2}{1 + \tan x}\)।

इसलिए
\(I = \int_{0}^{\pi/4} \log\frac{2}{1 + \tan x}\,dx = \int_{0}^{\pi/4} \log 2\,dx - \int_{0}^{\pi/4} \log(1 + \tan x)\,dx = \frac{\pi}{4}\log 2 - I\), (1) से।

अतः \(2I = \frac{\pi}{4}\log 2\), तथा \(I = \frac{\pi}{8}\log 2\)।
अतः \(\int_{0}^{\pi/4} \log(1 + \tan x)\,dx = \frac{\pi}{8}\log 2\)। इति सिद्धम्।

Q9a.en:
The ellipse \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) is symmetric about both axes and meets the \(x\)-axis at \((\pm a, 0)\). So the required area is 4 times the area in the first quadrant.

In the first quadrant, \(y = \frac{b}{a}\sqrt{a^2 - x^2}\), \(0 \le x \le a\).

Required area
\(= 4\int_{0}^{a} \frac{b}{a}\sqrt{a^2 - x^2}\,dx = \frac{4b}{a}\left[\frac{x}{2}\sqrt{a^2 - x^2} + \frac{a^2}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{x}{a}\right]_{0}^{a}\)
\(= \frac{4b}{a}\left[\left(0 + \frac{a^2}{2}\sin^{-1} 1\right) - (0 + 0)\right] = \frac{4b}{a} \cdot \frac{a^2}{2} \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} = \pi ab\).

Hence the area of the region bounded by the ellipse is \(\pi ab\) square units.
Q9a.hi:
दीर्घवृत्त \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) दोनों अक्षों के परितः सममित है तथा \(x\)-अक्ष को \((\pm a, 0)\) पर काटता है। अतः अभीष्ट क्षेत्रफल प्रथम चतुर्थांश के क्षेत्रफल का 4 गुना है।

प्रथम चतुर्थांश में \(y = \frac{b}{a}\sqrt{a^2 - x^2}\), \(0 \le x \le a\)।

अभीष्ट क्षेत्रफल
\(= 4\int_{0}^{a} \frac{b}{a}\sqrt{a^2 - x^2}\,dx = \frac{4b}{a}\left[\frac{x}{2}\sqrt{a^2 - x^2} + \frac{a^2}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{x}{a}\right]_{0}^{a}\)
\(= \frac{4b}{a}\left[\left(0 + \frac{a^2}{2}\sin^{-1} 1\right) - (0 + 0)\right] = \frac{4b}{a} \cdot \frac{a^2}{2} \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} = \pi ab\)।

अतः दीर्घवृत्त से घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल \(\pi ab\) वर्ग इकाई है।

Q9b.en:
Rearranging \(y - x\frac{dy}{dx} = x + y\frac{dy}{dx}\):
\(y - x = (x + y)\frac{dy}{dx}\), so \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{y - x}{x + y}\).
The right side is a homogeneous function of degree zero, so this is a homogeneous differential equation.

Put \(y = vx\), so \(\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}\):
\(v + x\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{vx - x}{x + vx} = \frac{v - 1}{1 + v}\)
\(x\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{v - 1}{1 + v} - v = \frac{v - 1 - v - v^2}{1 + v} = -\frac{1 + v^2}{1 + v}\).

Separating the variables:
\(\frac{1 + v}{1 + v^2}\,dv = -\frac{dx}{x}\), that is, \(\left(\frac{1}{1 + v^2} + \frac{v}{1 + v^2}\right)dv = -\frac{dx}{x}\).

Integrating:
\(\tan^{-1} v + \frac{1}{2}\log(1 + v^2) = -\log|x| + C\).

Putting \(v = \frac{y}{x}\):
\(\tan^{-1}\frac{y}{x} + \frac{1}{2}\log\frac{x^2 + y^2}{x^2} + \log|x| = C\)
\(\tan^{-1}\frac{y}{x} + \frac{1}{2}\log(x^2 + y^2) - \log|x| + \log|x| = C\).

Hence the general solution is \(\tan^{-1}\frac{y}{x} + \frac{1}{2}\log(x^2 + y^2) = C\), where \(C\) is an arbitrary constant.
Q9b.hi:
\(y - x\frac{dy}{dx} = x + y\frac{dy}{dx}\) को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करने पर:
\(y - x = (x + y)\frac{dy}{dx}\), अतः \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{y - x}{x + y}\)।
दायाँ पक्ष शून्य घात का समघातीय फलन है, अतः यह एक समघातीय अवकल समीकरण है।

माना \(y = vx\), तब \(\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}\):
\(v + x\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{vx - x}{x + vx} = \frac{v - 1}{1 + v}\)
\(x\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{v - 1}{1 + v} - v = \frac{v - 1 - v - v^2}{1 + v} = -\frac{1 + v^2}{1 + v}\)।

चरों को पृथक् करने पर:
\(\frac{1 + v}{1 + v^2}\,dv = -\frac{dx}{x}\), अर्थात् \(\left(\frac{1}{1 + v^2} + \frac{v}{1 + v^2}\right)dv = -\frac{dx}{x}\)।

समाकलन करने पर:
\(\tan^{-1} v + \frac{1}{2}\log(1 + v^2) = -\log|x| + C\)।

\(v = \frac{y}{x}\) रखने पर:
\(\tan^{-1}\frac{y}{x} + \frac{1}{2}\log\frac{x^2 + y^2}{x^2} + \log|x| = C\)
\(\tan^{-1}\frac{y}{x} + \frac{1}{2}\log(x^2 + y^2) - \log|x| + \log|x| = C\)।

अतः व्यापक हल \(\tan^{-1}\frac{y}{x} + \frac{1}{2}\log(x^2 + y^2) = C\) है, जहाँ \(C\) स्वेच्छ अचर है।
